subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades ship the version 4-to-8 Room migration with ownerless legacy outbox rows visible for manual recovery but permanently ineligible for automatic retry?
rationale: The design prevents cross-agent message replay, but it intentionally changes recovery behavior for existing persisted rows and therefore requires Android-owner approval.

options.title: Approve fail-closed migration
options.body: Ship the migration as designed after exact-head release-database and Android variant proof confirms safe upgrade behavior.

options.title: Define safe legacy recovery
options.body: Add a rule that can prove a legacy row's owner and cover it with migration and live-upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Split persistence changes
options.body: Land transient composer isolation separately and move cache and outbox schema changes to a dedicated migration PR.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Ship the migration as designed after exact-head release-database and Android variant proof confirms safe upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership documentation makes @obviyus the best available authority for Android upgrade and recovery behavior.
